supersedes_nothing: Historical collection and protocol identifiers describe the original study. Earlier routes are archived outside this standalone suite; see ../../PROVENANCE.md.

data.demographic_order_condition: fixed in every request; demographic-line position is held constant and is therefore not a source of within-collection variation and not an identifiable effect

changed_at_once: demographic line order fixed rather than varied
draws per (cell, answer) changed from 125 to 104
collection_design_changes_from_v1.consequence: a difference between v1 and v2 cannot be attributed to any one of these changes; the causal effect of fixed line order is not identified by this collection

panel.alignment: within each persona cell, each answer's 104 draws are independently permuted with default_rng(SeedSequence([panel_seed, cell_index, answer_index])) and read side by side
panel.independence_assumption: the six answers were rated in separate API calls; the aligned vectors assume independence across answer-specific draws and are not six ratings from one simulated individual

discovery.stratification: balanced by persona cell: 10 per cell, with the 7 cells taking an 11th drawn from the seed

group_selection.when: once, on the 167 discovery respondents, before any policy fit; never repeated inside a CV repeat
group_selection.candidate_universe: universal plus the 8 feature-level groups in the study's analysis_groups, frozen before scores were opened
group_selection.statistic: Pearson correlation between a candidate's 15 mean pairwise margins and the discovery population's 15 margins
group_selection.n_pairwise_margins_note: choose(6, 2) = 15 with six answers, where v1 had choose(5, 2) = 10; the rule is otherwise identical
group_selection.rule: the 4 lowest-correlation candidates plus 1 ordinary median-correlation candidate (the lower median of the remaining eligible candidates in ascending correlation), so the family is not composed entirely of outliers
group_selection.min_discovery_support_validation: validated against the reserved sample at run time; too few eligible candidates is an error, and the family is never silently shrunk or altered
group_selection.undefined_correlation: ineligible, never selected, recorded as undefined; not coerced to zero and not replaced by another statistic
group_selection.tie_break: low slots: correlation ascending; median slot: the lower median of the remaining eligible candidates in ascending correlation; then discovery support descending, then position in the candidate list; slots are filled low then median, and a candidate can fill only one slot
group_selection.complements: complementary groups may both be selected
group_selection.too_few_eligible: an error; the family is never silently shrunk
group_selection.low_end_sign_note: 'low' is the low end of the observed range, not a claim of negative correlation; each candidate's correlation is reported with its sign
group_selection.discovery_only: every number used to rank, filter and select comes from the reserved 167 discovery pseudo-respondents; no analysis respondent, CV fold or fitted policy is read
group_selection.not_tuned_to_the_result: the slot counts are fixed by the analysis configuration

cross_validation.test_fold_sizes: seven folds of 150 and three of 149 per repeat
cross_validation.train_fold_sizes: seven folds of 1347 and three of 1348 per repeat
cross_validation.welfare_comparator: empirical attainable welfare, refit on each test fold

estimand.per_split: d_rf = mean over the 50 seeds of Delta_rfs
estimand.headline: mean of the 100 split scores
estimand.not: pooling all out-of-fold predictions and then taking one maximum; the welfare ratio and the maximum are nonlinear, so that is a different estimand

inference.per_group: corrected paired gaps per selected group, Holm-adjusted p-values across the selected family; the intervals are marginal, not simultaneous

robustness.panel_seed_sensitivity: the primary route re-run at panel seeds 20260917-20260920, each in its own output directory; the five estimates are reported as a spread and are never pooled into a larger nominal sample

learner_radius_sweep.group_family: inherited unchanged from the primary v2 route
learner_radius_sweep.agreement_requirement: at tau = 0.5 the sweep's worst-group gap must equal the primary v2 headline to 1e-9

tables: mean and distribution of ratings by answer, overall and by persona cell
the two incorrect controls' ranks and win rates
correct-versus-incorrect rating separation overall and by feature group
preference contrasts for direct versus expressive and accessible versus technical correct answers
action-selection frequency by arm and selected group
descriptive_checks.negative_control_policy: a negative control scoring highly is a finding about this synthetic evaluator, not a reason to drop the answer or rerun the collection

conditional_on: the artificial answer-rating alignment and its panel seed
does_not_include: any claim about human demographic preferences
the causal effect of fixing the demographic line order

comparison_policy.reportable_inferential_comparison: pooled versus multigroup within this v2 collection
comparison_policy.v1_versus_v2: descriptive only; a side-by-side must be labelled descriptive and must list every confound in collection_design_changes_from_v1. Do not present a v1-v2 difference as the effect of fixed demographic order.
